title: Neuralink's New AI Protocol: The End of Smart Home Hubs?
description:
Neuralink's N3 implant puts a custom AI chip directly in the human motor cortex — processing thoughts in 50ms with no cloud, no hub, no voice assistant.

That's 10x faster than Alexa. And it changes everything for the smart home industry.

In this video, we break down:
- The N3 chip's on-device AI architecture
- Why 50ms response time kills the smart home hub
- Samsung's manufacturing partnership
- Real patient examples (Noland Arbaugh, Brad Smith, Jake)
- The honest gap between medical device and consumer product

This isn't science fiction. It's working today in 21 patients worldwide.
